names.zh: 加勒比海与巴哈马珊瑚礁

description.zh: 跨越多个司法辖区的热带浅海珊瑚礁观察场景。鹿角珊瑚与鹿角大珊瑚的历史分布包括巴哈马、佛罗里达和加勒比海，但现存群体分布零散；本条目是区域级定位，不保证任一具体潜点可见。
description.en: A broad tropical shallow-reef observation scene spanning several jurisdictions. Staghorn and elkhorn coral historically range across the Bahamas, Florida and the Caribbean, but surviving colonies are patchy; this is a regional locator, not a guarantee of sightings at any dive site.

note.zh: NOAA 记录其分布包括巴哈马、佛罗里达和加勒比海；现存群体局部且分散，具体潜点需核对当地调查。
note.en: NOAA records the range across the Bahamas, Florida and the Caribbean; surviving colonies are localised and patchy, so check local surveys for a specific dive site.

note.zh: NOAA 物种资料页记录其浅海礁区范围。
note.en: NOAA species profile documents its shallow-reef range.

note.zh: NOAA 记录其分布包括巴哈马、佛罗里达和加勒比海；具体地点的存续情况应以当地监测资料为准。
note.en: NOAA records the range across the Bahamas, Florida and the Caribbean; local monitoring is needed to confirm surviving colonies at a particular site.
